name: callnav
description: Jump from Python call sites to implementations observed in a recorded run.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Runtime navigation is available; running capture scripts requires a trusted workspace.

callnav.pythonPath.description: Python 3.11+ on the workspace host. Relative executable paths resolve against the workspace folder; bare names use PATH. Empty uses the Python extension's selected interpreter, then python3 (python on Windows). No CallNav pip installation is needed.

callnav.shellPath.description: Shell executable for .sh/.bash scripts and Record Command. Must support -c for commands.

callnav.scriptArguments.description: Arguments passed literally to Record Script. For shell expansion or a different command, use Record Command.

callnav.workingDirectory.description: Capture working directory. Relative paths resolve against the chosen workspace folder.

callnav.includeRoots.description: Additional source directories to record, such as Megatron-LM. Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder.

callnav.ray.description: Record Ray Actor submission-to-worker calls. Workers must inherit the capture environment.

callnav.adapter.description: Optional iteration-budget adapter. slime supports synchronous train.py only; for train_async.py or VERL set the step budget in the launch script.

callnav.iterations.description: Outer-iteration budget when the slime adapter is selected.

callnav.environment.description: Environment variables for the capture, such as CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Applied on top of the workspace extension host's environment.

callnav.indexPath.description: Runtime index to load. ${workspaceFolder} resolves against the active document's workspace folder.
